core_obligations: Local ring limit: the local ring at the closed point of the limit is the colimit of the finite-level local rings; morphisms into the limit near the point are computed by the characterization proposition at the local rings.
Glueing assembly: the finite-level morphism data near the point glue to a morphism of the limit neighborhoods (glueing of schemes).
Compatibility: the glued morphism's pullbacks recover the given data at every finite level.
proof_roadmap: Local rings as colimits; Hom computation.
difficulty_reason: Glueing of schemes + characterization proposition for the local ring limit: two engines with the morphism-level bookkeeping (not just objects).

compared.difference: The sibling glues OBJECTS near the closed point (delivered as L30222); this lemma glues MORPHISMS. Different statements over the same architecture; both delivered.
